# Obsidian Vault

> A published Obsidian vault: 54 markdown notes. Every page is plain HTML; pages cross-link, so start anywhere and follow links.

## Machine-readable

- [Index (HTML, followable links)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/obsidian-vault/vault-index.html)
- [Full index (JSON, with note bodies)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/obsidian-vault/static/contentIndex.json)
- [Light index (JSON, no bodies)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/obsidian-vault/static/contentIndex.light.json)
- [Index (plain text)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/obsidian-vault/vault-index.txt)
